scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: bun run db:push && bun run db:seed-if-empty && cd apps/api && bun --hot src/index.ts
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run start:api" "bun run start:web"
scripts.build:all: bun run --filter @blasti/web build && bun run --filter @blasti/api build
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build:export && bun run --filter @blasti/desktop build
scripts.build:mobile: bun run build:export && bun run --filter @blasti/mobile cap:sync:android
scripts.mobile:android: bun run build:mobile && bun run mobile:studio
scripts.mobile:apk: bun run build:mobile && node scripts/gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:apk:release: bun run build:mobile && node scripts/gradle.js assembleRelease
scripts.electron:dev: bun run db:generate:desktop && cd apps/desktop && bun x electron . --dev
scripts.electron:dev:full: concurrently -n api,web,desktop -c blue,green,yellow "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web" "bun run db:generate:desktop && cd apps/desktop && bun x electron . --dev"
